description: DCC operators monitor substations and feeders and operate breakers, reclosers, and capacitor banks through SCADA
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without SCADA, every switching step needs a crew at the device; outages last longer and switching errors endanger crews. 4 h is the longest the DCC can run on crews and radio in normal weather. RPO covers the SCADA database and displays (nightly backup); real-time values refresh on reconnection
manual_workaround: Station crews dispatched to key substations; switching by radio from the DCC; operator log on paper
dependent_third_parties: SCADA vendor (support); fiber, radio, and cellular carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: System operators; DCC and backup DCC; substation crews

description: OMS predicts outage locations from calls, AMI, and SCADA events and dispatches crews
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Restoration slows sharply without outage prediction; in a hurricane the MTD shrinks to 4 h. Point-in-time database restore gives a 1 h RPO
manual_workaround: Paper trouble tickets; dispatch by radio; outage map from the call center
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; OMS software vendor; cellular carrier

business_process: BES line protection at Substation N and Substation E
description: 115 kV line protection relays detect faults on BES lines; protection staff maintain settings and test under PRC-005
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Relays run locally and keep protecting if SCADA or remote access is lost. If relay integrity is in doubt the transmission owner may take the line out of service; restoring approved settings and testing takes about 8 h. RPO 0: the last approved settings file is the recovery point
manual_workaround: Transmission owner operates with the line out of service; protection staff reload approved settings on site
dependent_systems: SYS-04; relay engineering workstation; settings file server
dependent_people_or_facilities: Protection engineers and technicians; Substation N and E

business_process: Customer contact center, IVR, and portal
description: Customers report outages and handle accounts by phone, IVR, and the portal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Outage calls feed the OMS; during storms call volume rises tenfold. Vendor SaaS with a 1 h RPO
manual_workaround: Outage reporting by recorded message; manual call logging

description: Collect interval reads, outage and restoration events, and remote connect and disconnect
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Meters store interval data for weeks, so reads are not lost. Remote connects can wait or be done by field staff
manual_workaround: Field connects and disconnects; estimated reads

business_process: Wholesale power scheduling and load forecasting
description: Daily day-ahead schedule and 7-day forecast sent to the wholesale supplier
process_owner: Manager of Power Supply and Rates
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The supplier needs a schedule each day; a missed or poor schedule can cost more than $500K on a peak day. The supplier can reuse the prior day's schedule
manual_workaround: Reuse the prior day's schedule adjusted for weather; the supplier's own forecast
dependent_third_parties: Wholesale power supplier; weather data provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Load Forecasting Analyst; Manager of Power Supply and Rates

description: Email, chat, and file sharing for coordination
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Storm coordination relies on chat and email, but radio and phones cover critical coordination

description: Bill calculation, printing, and payment posting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Bills run daily in cycles; a 3-day delay is recoverable. Payments continue through the processor
manual_workaround: Delay bill cycles; payments continue through the processor's hosted page
dependent_third_parties: CIS vendor; payment processor; bill print vendor

description: Design work, GIS updates, and work orders
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Work can be deferred; GIS changes are low volume

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding, and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; missing it has legal and morale impact
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider
